paras: Webwinder Path winds through the lower Stonetalon Mountains, linking Malaka'jin with Mirkfallon Lake. Spiders and native beasts roam its crags and woods.

Webwinder Path runs from Malaka'jin toward Mirkfallon Lake through the lower Stonetalon Mountains. Thick webs hang among the trees and along the jagged cliffs. Mountain spiders prowl the road, while thunder lizards and territorial rams roam nearby. Travelers must watch their step along the winding route.
